description:
Tent Hotels Assistant helps guests explore the chain, find hotel information, check room availability and prices, and review room types and optional extras.
Guests can ask about hotel amenities, services, policies, and check-in and check-out times. The assistant can also help create a booking after explicit confirmation and retrieve, modify, or cancel an existing booking when the required booking details are provided.
Example questions:
“Which Tent Hotels can I choose from?”
“What are the check-in and check-out times at tent Torremolinos?”
“What room types are available?”
“Do you have rooms for two adults next weekend?”
“Help me change my booking dates.”

Reservation actions may require booking details and guest information. Availability and conditions are provided by the hotel booking system.

name: tent-hotels

positive.description: List tent Hotels properties in the chain.
positive.prompt: Which tent Hotels can I choose from?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the official list of tent Hotels properties with guest-facing names and locations, without exposing internal hotel or chain identifiers.

positive.prompt: What benefits does the tent Hotels club offer?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the tent Hotels club benefits from official chain information, including the Rookie, Expert and Legend levels, discounts and member perks, without asking for personal data.

positive.description: Answer hotel-specific amenity and policy questions.
positive.prompt: At tent Torremolinos, what are the check-in and check-out times, and does it have a pool?
positive.expected_behavior: Matches tent Torremolinos to the correct hotel, retrieves the hotel profile, and answers with official check-in, check-out, and pool information only.

positive.description: List room details for a specific hotel.
positive.prompt: What room types does tent Torremolinos offer, including capacities and bed configurations?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns room names, capacities, sizes, bed configurations, and relevant amenities for tent Torremolinos from the room profiles.

positive.description: Check availability without creating a booking.
positive.prompt: Do you have rooms at tent Lloret de Mar for 2 adults from May 14, 2027 to May 16, 2027?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns available rooms, board options, prices, tax status, and cancellation summaries if available; otherwise clearly says no availability was found.

negative.description: An unrelated cooking request must not trigger the hotel tools.
negative.prompt: Give me a recipe for a good chocolate cake.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any tent Hotels tool. The request is unrelated to the hotels, so it is handled without the plugin.

negative.description: A general knowledge question must not trigger the hotel tools.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any tent Hotels tool or mention tent Hotels. The question is answered without using the plugin.

negative.description: An unrelated coding request must not trigger the hotel tools.
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that checks whether a number is prime.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any tent Hotels tool. The request is unrelated to hotel information or reservations, so it is handled without the plugin.

review.commerce_description: The plugin supports Tent Hotels accommodation reservations and optional stay-related extras across the chain's properties. Booking creation, date-change acceptance and full cancellation require explicit guest confirmation. Payment or finalization, when required, is completed through the hotel booking system link outside chat; card details are not collected in chat.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Tent Hotels with chain hotel directory, hotel information, availability, reservations and conversation ratings.
